The structure of Y₄B₂ (reduced formula Y₂B) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing six atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis gives boron centers 10 geometric neighbors (2 B, 8 Y) and yttrium centers 15 neighbors (4 B, 11 Y) across the two independent orbits. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between B 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between B and Y 15-vertex polyhedra.
